{{Name|Treasure Totem|1|class=inline}} }} The '''Totem Mask''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be [[Tailoring#Hats|tailored]] at the sewing machine inside [[2 Willow Lane|Emily's house]] or the [[Sewing Machine]] received as a reward for the [[Quests#Rock Rejuvenation|"Rock Rejuvenation"]] special order. It requires [[Cloth]] and either a [[Rain Totem]], [[Warp Totem: Farm]], [[Warp Totem: Mountains]], [[Warp Totem: Beach]], [[Warp Totem: Desert]], [[Warp Totem: Island]], or [[Treasure Totem]]. It can also be obtained from [[Desert Festival#Emily's Outfit Services|Emily's outfit services]] at the [[Desert Festival]]. Male players have a ≈2% chance to receive the outfit with the Totem Mask. ==Notes== * The Totem Mask outfit also includes the [[File:Shirt153.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Shirts|Fake Muscles Shirt]] (dyed RGB value 249,174,137) and [[File:Shorts.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Pants|Shorts]] (dyed RGB value 18,140,23). ==References== Male players have 47 possible outfits (1/47 ≈ 2.13%). See Content\Data\MakeoverOutfits.xnb.
